FN-5V8QQ36-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 263
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/05/2026
House Bill 263 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Attorney General to
investigate claims through the Consumer Interest Division of unlawful disposition of certain
consumer data under certain conditions, which could be offset by civil fines imposed, not
exceeding $3,000 per violation, as provided by this bill.
